changelog: Say "go to start" — or "শুরুতে যাও" in Bengali — alone while dictating in WhatsApp or Messenger and the cursor jumps to the start of the text; "go to end" / "শেষে যাও" jumps to the end. The hands-free way back after tapping a word mid-message to fix it: without it, the next dictated segment lands in the middle of the message. Moving the cursor deletes nothing, so undo, redo and the delete commands keep working. Saying the words inside a longer sentence still types them as normal text.
